stories.title: Son Dakika... Fed merakla beklenen faiz kararını açıkladı

en.title: Fed Announces Highly Anticipated Interest Rate Decision
en.summary: The Federal Reserve announced an interest rate increase of 25 basis points, bringing the rate to 3.7 percent, in a decision that global markets had been closely watching.

stories.title: Kaybolan Elif bebeğin annesi ve babası tutuklandı

en.title: Parents of Missing Baby Elif Arrested
en.summary: The mother and father of 11-month-old Büşra, who disappeared in Divriği district of Sivas, have been arrested among nine suspects detained in the investigation.

stories.title: Önce ‘sattı’ sonra ‘öldürdü’ dedi… 11 aylık bebek, 6 gündür aranıyor: Büşra bebeğin annesi ve babası tutuklandı

en.title: Parents of 11-Month-Old Büşra Arrested; Baby Missing for 6 Days
en.summary: The parents of 11-month-old Büşra Balıkçı, who went missing in Sivas six days ago, have been arrested along with eight other suspects in connection with the case.

stories.title: Acı haberi Kolombiya Cumhurbaşkanı duyurdu: Türk iş insanı ve 4 kişi ölü bulundu

en.title: Colombian President Announces Turkish Businessman and Four Others Found Dead
en.summary: The wreckage of a plane used by Turkish businessman Mehmet Çankaya, which went missing on September 13, has been discovered in Colombia with five people reportedly dead.

en.title: Öcalan's villa caused dispute between AKP's Tayyar and Selvi
en.summary: A villa constructed for Abdullah Öcalan on İmralı island sparked a disagreement between AKP politician Şamil Tayyar and Abdülkadir Selvi.

en.title: Colombia's President announces: No survivors on aircraft used by Turkish businessman
en.summary: Colombia's President Abelardo de la Espriella confirmed that an aircraft used by Turkish businessman Mehmet Çankaya was found, with all five people on board killed.

stories.title: AKP'li Tayyar'dan Selvi'ye 'Öcalan'ın villası' çıkışı: 'Hobi bahçesi olmadığı kesin'

en.title: AKP's Tayyar responds to Selvi over 'Öcalan's villa': 'It's definitely not a hobby garden'
en.summary: AKP politician Şamil Tayyar responded to commentator Abdülkadir Selvi's remarks about a residence on Imralı, stating it is not a hobby garden.

stories.title: Hedef Holding Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Namık Kemal Gökalp gözaltına alındı

en.title: Hedef Holding Board Chairman Namık Kemal Gökalp detained
en.summary: Namık Kemal Gökalp, board chairman of Info Yatırım and Hedef Holding, which have operated in capital markets for years, was taken into custody.

stories.title: Ünlü oyuncu Münir Canar hayatını kaybetti

en.title: Renowned actor Münir Canar dies
en.summary: Münir Canar, a master figure in theatre, cinema and television, has passed away.

stories.title: Ticaret Bakanlığı duyurdu: Güvensiz peluş anahtarlıklar toplatılıyor

en.title: Trade Ministry announces: Unsafe plush keychains being recalled
en.summary: The Trade Ministry identified safety violations in plush keychains intended for children use, including excessive chemical and nickel emissions and choking hazards. The product has been banned from sale and existing stock is being withdrawn from the market.

stories.title: Sofranın ötesinde köklü bir mirasa sahip çıkılıyor

en.title: A deep-rooted legacy beyond the table is being preserved
en.summary: Bursa, as the Ottomans' first capital, developed a distinctive food culture where palace, charitable kitchen, and merchant cuisines coexisted. The city's centuries-old culinary heritage is being protected through various cultural events.

en.title: International 5th Bursa Gastronomy Festival coming
en.summary: Bursa Metropolitan Municipality will host the International 5th Bursa Gastronomy Festival on September 18-20 at Merinos Park, themed "Flavors of Conquest", to promote the city's rich culinary culture internationally.

stories.title: Topraktan sofraya, yeni değer zincirinde lokomotif rol oynuyor

en.title: Playing locomotive role in new value chain, from farm to table
en.summary: Referans Holding's general manager stated that the farm-to-table approach guides gastronomy, and the company's integrated structure connecting agricultural sources with production and catering operations provides supply chain control, traceability, and cost management advantages.

stories.title: “Bursa, gastronomide elindeki büyük değeri doğru yönetmeli”

en.title: Bursa must properly manage its significant gastronomic value
en.summary: The head of a gastronomy association states that Bursa has not sufficiently converted its culinary and tourism assets into economic gains, arguing the city needs better management of existing strengths rather than creating new value.
